  SELECT store."StoreName" AS store_name,
         calendar."CalendarYear" AS yr,
         product_category."ProductCategoryName" AS category_name,
         MEASURE(sales.sales_amount) AS amt
  FROM sales
  CROSS JOIN store
  CROSS JOIN calendar
  CROSS JOIN product
  CROSS JOIN product_subcategory
  CROSS JOIN product_category
  WHERE calendar."CalendarYear" IN (2008, 2009)
    AND store."StoreType" = 'Store'
  GROUP BY store."StoreName", calendar."CalendarYear", product_category."ProductCategoryName"
),
pivot AS (
  SELECT store_name,
         category_name,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2008 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS amt_2008,
         SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2009 THEN amt ELSE 0 END) AS amt_2009
  FROM base
  GROUP BY store_name, category_name
),
store_agg AS (
  SELECT store_name,
         SUM(amt_2008) AS s08,
         SUM(amt_2009) AS s09,
         SUM(amt_2008 - amt_2009) AS total_dec
  FROM pivot
  GROUP BY store_name
),
declining AS (
  SELECT store_name, s08, s09, total_dec, total_dec / NULLIF(s08, 0) AS decline_rate
  FROM store_agg
  WHERE total_dec > 0 AND s08 > 0
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM declining
  ORDER BY decline_rate DESC, total_dec DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
cat_dec AS (
  SELECT p.store_name,
         p.category_name,
         p.amt_2008 - p.amt_2009 AS cat_dec
  FROM pivot p
  JOIN top3 t ON t.store_name = p.store_name
  WHERE p.amt_2008 > p.amt_2009
),
ranked_cat AS (
  SELECT store_name,
         category_name,
         cat_dec,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_name ORDER BY cat_dec DESC) AS rn
  FROM cat_dec
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.decline_rate DESC) AS "名次",
       t.store_name AS "门店",
       ROUND(t.decline_rate * 100, 2) AS "门店降幅(%)",
       r.category_name AS "拖累最多的品类",
       ROUND(r.cat_dec, 2) AS "该品类销售减少额",
       ROUND(r.cat_dec / NULLIF(t.total_dec, 0) * 100, 2) AS "占门店总减少额(%)"
FROM top3 t
JOIN ranked_cat r
  ON r.store_name = t.store_name
 AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY t.decline_rate DESC;
turns.assumption: 同店口径只取实体自营门店（StoreType='Store'），门店降幅 =（2008 销售额 − 2009 销售额）÷ 2008 销售额并以正数表示，品类减少额与占比都只基于能匹配到产品品类的销售额（缺产品主数据的交易不计入，分子分母同口径）。

WITH daily_category AS (
  SELECT
    product_category."ProductCategoryName" AS category_name,
    online_sales."DateKey" AS date_key,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM online_sales."DateKey") IN (0, 6) THEN 'WeekEnd'
      ELSE 'WorkDay'
    END AS day_type,
    MEASURE(online_sales.sales_amount) AS daily_sales
  FROM online_sales
  CROSS JOIN product
  CROSS JOIN product_subcategory
  CROSS JOIN product_category
  WHERE online_sales."DateKey" BETWEEN DATE '2007-01-01' AND DATE '2009-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    product_category."ProductCategoryName",
    online_sales."DateKey",
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(DOW FROM online_sales."DateKey") IN (0, 6) THEN 'WeekEnd'
      ELSE 'WorkDay'
    END
),
category_avg AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN day_type = 'WeekEnd' THEN daily_sales ELSE 0 END)
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_type = 'WeekEnd' THEN date_key END), 0) AS weekend_avg,
    SUM(CASE WHEN day_type = 'WorkDay' THEN daily_sales ELSE 0 END)
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_type = 'WorkDay' THEN date_key END), 0) AS workday_avg,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_type = 'WeekEnd' THEN date_key END) AS weekend_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_type = 'WorkDay' THEN date_key END) AS workday_days
  FROM daily_category
  GROUP BY category_name
)
SELECT
  category_name AS "产品品类",
  ROUND(weekend_avg, 2) AS "周末日均销售额",
  ROUND(workday_avg, 2) AS "工作日日均销售额",
  weekend_days AS "周末天数",
  workday_days AS "工作日天数",
  ROUND(weekend_avg - workday_avg, 2) AS "差额",
  ROUND((weekend_avg - workday_avg) / NULLIF(workday_avg, 0) * 100, 2) AS "高出百分比"
FROM category_avg
ORDER BY category_name;
